svg.title: Booking · Payment Saga
svg.desc: Swimlane diagram of the choreographed saga between Booking and Payment: a PENDING booking with a 15-minute seat hold, one synchronous payability check, gateway checkout, a transactional-outbox PaymentSucceeded event, a conditional-UPDATE confirm that wins the race with expiry, and — when the money arrives after the hold died — an automatic refund as compensation, not a rollback.
svg.text: meanwhile: the 15-min hold clock runs — expiry races the confirm
expiresAt set · seats HELD, not sold
the ONLY sync hop in the saga
Paid. Are the seats still ours?
UPDATE ... WHERE status=PENDING AND expiresAt > now
already charged — nothing left to roll back
carries paymentId — refund needs NO lookup
No distributed transaction — guarded steps plus events; the unhappy path is a refund, not a rollback.
SOLID = synchronous HTTP · DASHED = asynchronous event · every event travels via screenmaster-exchange
